node.title: Prize N=256 profile-(3,6) cofactor-512 exclusion
node.closure: dual exact radius census plus dual exact norm ledger
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(3,6,S=18) cofactor 512 is impossible. Its multiplicity mu=9 and bounded residual E in {2,...,17} contain four normalized vectors, all at E=15 or E=17; every exact quotient Norm/512 lies below the prize interval.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: two radius engines agree on 2912 affine orbits, 438120 candidate heavy supports, 3504960 exact sign tests, and four vectors. FLINT and PARI agree on their exact norms. Eight profile-(3,6) cofactors remain.
